thought.text: The app stack is booting (migrations running). Let me wait for services to become healthy and check status:

reasoning_content: Process-compose is running and services are starting up with Alembic migrations executing. I'll monitor the log file to track which services have reached a healthy state, then wait a bit for everything to stabilize before checking the process-compose API status.

action.command:
sleep 90; cd /workspace
echo "=== process status via API ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/process/ 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
for ns, procs in d.items():
    for name, p in procs.items():
        st = p.get('status', {}).get('state', 'unknown')
        print(f'{name}: {st}')
" 2>&1 | head -50
